rows.label: Toyota Land Cruiser
rows.hook: has a reputation as a nearly indestructible off-roader that crosses deserts and outback tracks worldwide

rows.label: Toyota RAV4
rows.hook: helped launch the small crossover craze and became one of the best-selling SUVs on the planet

rows.label: Volkswagen Beetle
rows.hook: has a rounded bug-like shape and a rear-mounted engine, and starred as Herbie in a series of films

rows.label: Ferrari F40
rows.hook: was a raw, turbocharged supercar and the last one approved by its founder before he died

rows.label: BMW M3
rows.hook: is the high-performance sports coupe and sedan that has topped track tests for decades

rows.label: Chevrolet Impala
rows.hook: is a full-size family car named after an African antelope and beloved in lowrider culture

rows.label: Honda CR-V
rows.hook: is a compact SUV that has been a suburban family favorite and top seller for decades

rows.label: Ford Model T
rows.hook: put the world on wheels through assembly-line production and a low price, nicknamed the Tin Lizzie

rows.label: Mazda RX-7
rows.hook: is a lightweight sports car powered by a spinning triangular rotary engine instead of pistons

rows.label: Toyota Supra
rows.hook: is a sports car famous for its tuneable straight-six engine and a starring turn in a Fast & Furious film

rows.label: Nissan Skyline
rows.hook: is a long-running line of sporty coupes whose turbo versions became street-racing legends

rows.label: BMW 3 Series
rows.hook: is the compact luxury sport sedan that its maker sells more of than almost any other model

rows.label: Tesla Cybertruck
rows.hook: is an angular, stainless-steel electric pickup with sharp, unpainted, flat panels

rows.label: Nissan GT-R
rows.hook: is a turbocharged all-wheel-drive supercar nicknamed Godzilla that humbles far pricier cars

rows.label: Dodge Viper
rows.hook: is a brutish sports car with a huge ten-cylinder engine and side-exit exhausts, named for a venomous snake

rows.label: Mazda3
rows.description: automobile manufactured by the Mazda Motor Corporation

rows.label: Honda Fit
rows.hook: is a tiny hatchback with flip-up rear seats and a surprisingly roomy cabin, sold as the Jazz in many markets

rows.label: Tesla Model Y

rows.label: BMW M5
rows.hook: is the original super sedan, a fast family four-door with a big, powerful engine

rows.label: Toyota Yaris
rows.hook: is a small, thrifty hatchback that also has a rally-bred hot version

rows.label: Mini

rows.label: Audi A8

rows.label: BMW X7
